visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Loop and Function Instead of Repetition
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Each element is added by hand and the count is a magic number. Use a loop inside a reusable average function. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: The loop works for any array size, sizeof computes the count so it can never go out of date, and the function can be reused for any list of numbers.
